title: //src/test/shell/bazel:external_integration_test#test_fetch is failing on OS X since https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/713a78

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

body:
https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/713a78 probably uncovered a longer bug on OS X for this test.

Found using git bisect.

See http://ci.bazel.io/job/Bazel/JAVA_VERSION=1.7,PLATFORM_NAME=darwin-x86_64/290/console for failure.
